data.title: BTC Looks Directionless After 7 Weeks of Losses
data.description: In October we argued bitcoin's bear market ended in June. BTC has since lost its 50-week average and traded below the June low, an outcome that had never followed a  comparable reclaim of the average. We withdraw our call and set out what may come next.
